screens.screen: home, scrolled to the feature grid (six service cards)
cargo: add new item (product details form)

notes: Repo: ardev-dev/shipperit-flutter (Flutter, GetX). English/LTR; ThemeData() sets no font family, so the platform font is used. Images are the repo's own assets (homePage/banners.png, world_maps.png); FontAwesome glyphs (child, baby, chair, dollar, weight) come from the font bundled in the app's own web build (repo ardev-dev/shipperit). The code base is nearly identical to ardev-dev/DBCargo, so the two slugs were given complementary screens: here the home is shown scrolled down to its feature grid (the top of the same home, with the tracking banner, is DBCargo's screen 1). The app is also deployed as Flutter web and has a tablet/desktop banner, but that layout puts the title text over the illustration, so the phone layout was drawn. Doubts: (1) it is a UI prototype with hard-coded content; airports NewYork (NYC) / Mumbai (BAS) are the controller defaults, the date, passenger count, product link and product name are sample values (the fields are empty by default; "10.0", "1.0", "1", "Total (5)", "food" and the app-bar route NYC to BAS are the code's own constants). (2) Staggered-grid card heights and the outlined text-field height (60px) are estimated from Material defaults. (3) Code spelling kept: "NewYork", lower-case field labels.
